behavior.name: Example 5
behavior.author: David Conner
behavior.description:
Demonstrates using a PriorityContainer inside a ConcurrencyContainer.
The PriorityContainer (Priority_Work) runs a two-step sequential initialization sequence that blocks all sibling states from executing — including deferring their on_enter calls — until the priority sequence completes.
Both Priority_Work and Normal_Work must complete (AND condition) before the ConcurrencyContainer exits with 'finished'.

param.name: waiting_time_priority_a
param.label: Priority wait A
param.hint: Waiting time for the first priority initialization step (Init_A)

param.name: waiting_time_priority_b
param.label: Priority wait B
param.hint: Waiting time for the second priority initialization step (Init_B)

param.name: waiting_time_normal
param.label: Normal work wait
param.hint: Waiting time for Normal_Work, which begins only after the priority sequence completes
